universal_patterns.pattern: any holder of a license[^.]*under this (?:title|chapter)
regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and the Department of Health Professions
any regulatory board within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation or the Department of Health Professions
any state board, or other body charged by law with the responsibility of examining persons desiring to engage in a regulated business or profession

proposal.rationale: Chapter 1 of Title 54.1 contains general provisions that apply across both umbrella departments (DPOR and DHP) and thus span the entire Title 54.1. Sections like § 54.1-101, § 54.1-101.1, § 54.1-103, § 54.1-104, § 54.1-104.1 repeatedly invoke "the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and the Department of Health Professions" or "any regulatory board within" these departments, signaling title-wide applicability. § 54.1-101.1 uses "Whenever in this title" explicitly. § 54.1-102 references "any state board... charged by law with... a regulated business or profession," again title-wide. I add these as title-level universal patterns. Sections that only enumerate specific named boards (like § 54.1-106) remain non-universal — they list specific practice-act boards rather than asserting universal scope, and should be handled via the existing trigger patterns or left undetermined. Chapter and section cite patterns and trigger phrases remain unchanged from the prior proposal.
